title: 026-N3 · Parcel opened in error, resealed
initial_explanation: We are the coordinator, Iona Quill. The client is Neris Fawn, the intended recipient. From the case card: carrier review has located the misdelivered parcel DL-026, and recovery should be managed by the carrier without exposing the other household's details.

coordinator.name: Iona Quill
coordinator.responsibility: Get the carrier to recover and correctly redeliver DL-026 and obtain confirmation of the corrected handover and receipt.

recipient.name: Neris Fawn
recipient.responsibility: Ask for carrier recovery and redelivery, and confirm receipt.

investigations.name: Delivery investigations
investigations.responsibility: Review the misdelivery and locate DL-026.

recovery.name: Recovery team
recovery.responsibility: Recover DL-026 from the wrong stop, redeliver it to the verified order address and record the corrected handover; holds the third-party contact details.

goal: Get the carrier to recover DL-026 and redeliver it to the intended recipient, with the carrier's record of the corrected handover and the recipient's confirmation of receipt, without exposing the other household's details.
limits: Do not reveal the wrong-address resident's name, address or contact details.
Make no claim about the quality of the contents.
Do not choose for the customer or treat a choice as a confirmed booking.
